P1.title: Residue-order / peptide-adjacency contract
P1.verdict_impact: Fixes fabricated peptide re-pairing for insertion-coded residues (e.g. 1PPE 184A/184). May change LAW-110/120/125/135/160 observations for such deposits; no threshold definitions changed. No false veto is silenced; the ordering is corrected to source order.
P1.acceptance: get_sequential_residues and Tier1Measurements._extract order by authoritative sequence position (label_seq_id when valid else res_seq) with a stable sort; source order preserved for same-position residues; full backend suite green.

P2.title: Source-backed coverage denominator
P2.verdict_impact: LAW-105 coverage denominator now uses the authoritative polymer sequence (SEQRES / entity_poly_seq) when available, including positions absent from coordinates. When the source sequence cannot be established, LAW-105 fails closed (MEASUREMENT_FAILED, observed=None) instead of claiming observed-only 100%. The returned coverage (used by adjudicator/API/evaluator/PDF) matches the LAW-105 source-backed value. Structures whose source sequence equals observed coordinates report identical coverage to before; structures with unresolved positions now report reduced coverage. Verdict may change for inputs with missing sequence positions; no threshold changed.
P2.acceptance: LAW-105 reports coverage_basis (source_polymer_sequence vs source_polymer_sequence_unavailable), numerator, denominator, source_sequence_available, and per-chain source counts. Missing source sequence fails closed. Full backend suite green.

rollback: The P1 change is confined to backend/tos/engine/coord_math.py, tier1_measurements.py, ingestion/{processor,atom_selection}.py, and a new test file. Reverting those four source edits restores prior ordering behavior; the new test file can be removed. No data migration, hash-lock change, or law-semantic change is introduced by P1.
